meta.name: Accans Sec Skills
meta.description: Security-focused skills, agents and commands for Claude Code and Cowork. Build your install from the catalog.

pentest.label: Pentest
pentest.desc: Offensive and red team work — recon to reporting.

items.name: Security Review
items.desc: Security review workflow for a PR, feature or codebase — scope, automated scans, manual OWASP/CWE pattern-check, prioritize and report. Uses secure-coding as pattern library.

items.name: Threat Modeler
items.desc: STRIDE and LINDDUN threat-modeling agent for a service, feature or integration. Builds a DFD, enumerates threats per element, ranks mitigations and flags residual risk.

items.name: Verification Loop
items.desc: Structured red-team pass over your own output — surface assumptions, gaps, failure modes and security red flags before shipping.

items.name: Secure Coding Standards
items.desc: Language-agnostic secure-coding patterns — input validation, injection-safe APIs, authN/authZ, crypto, secrets, dependency hygiene. The default lens when no framework-specific skill applies.

items.name: Secrets Scanner
items.desc: Detect and remediate leaked credentials in code and git-history — entropy/regex scanning with gitleaks/trufflehog/detect-secrets, rotate-first incident response, and pre-commit/CI gating to prevent reoccurrence.

items.name: Security Gate
items.desc: Pre-merge security gate on the current branch — runs secrets, SAST and dep-vuln checks on changed code, honors documented exceptions, returns a hard PASS/FAIL verdict.

items.name: CVE Triage
items.desc: Triage dependency vulnerabilities against CISA KEV, EPSS, reachability and compensating controls — turn a raw Dependabot/Snyk/osv-scanner dump into fix-now/sprint/quarter/accept decisions with rationale.

items.name: SAST Orchestrator
items.desc: SAST orchestration for Semgrep, CodeQL and SonarQube. Covers tool selection, ruleset curation, PR-comment integration, noise reduction with baselines, and language-specific linters (bandit, gosec, brakeman, eslint-security) when they add coverage.

items.name: DAST Workflow
items.desc: ZAP automation and Burp collaborator playbooks with auth-state handling.

items.name: IaC Security
items.desc: IaC misconfig scanning and cloud-aware review for Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible and Pulumi. Covers tool orchestration (checkov/tfsec/kics/cfn-nag), policy-as-code (OPA/Conftest), CIS benchmark mapping, IAM over-permission detection, drift monitoring.

items.name: Container Hardening
items.desc: Docker and OCI image hardening — base-image selection, USER/caps/read-only FS discipline, distroless migration, build-time scanning with trivy/grype, image signing via sigstore, and runtime guardrails (seccomp, AppArmor).

items.name: Kubernetes Security
items.desc: Kubernetes security review — RBAC discipline, Pod Security Standards (baseline/restricted), NetworkPolicy default-deny, admission controllers (Kyverno/Gatekeeper/VAP), External Secrets Operator, and runtime monitoring via Falco and audit logs.

items.name: API Security
items.desc: API security review against OWASP API Top 10 2023. Covers auth (OAuth2/JWT/API-keys), object-level authorization (BOLA/IDOR), schema validation, rate-limiting, CORS, SSRF, and GraphQL-specific concerns (introspection, query depth, batching).

items.name: Supply Chain Defense
items.desc: Software supply-chain defense — SBOM generation (CycloneDX/SPDX), SLSA build provenance, artifact signing with sigstore/cosign, dependency-confusion and typosquat defense, and consumer-side verification of what you pull in.

items.name: Django Security
items.desc: CSRF, ORM-based SQLi, template-injection, admin hardening and deploy checklist.

items.name: Spring Boot Security
items.desc: OAuth2, JWT, method-level auth, secure API configs and actuator lockdown.

items.name: Rails Security
items.desc: Brakeman integration, mass-assignment, strong-params and Devise hardening.

items.name: Next.js Security
items.desc: SSR leak patterns, Server Actions auth, auth.js config and middleware pitfalls.

items.name: CI/CD Hardening
items.desc: CI/CD pipeline hardening for GitHub Actions and GitLab CI — trust-model (pull_request_target vs pull_request), action pinning to SHA, OIDC-based cloud access, permissions minimization, runner isolation, and supply-chain gates (SLSA provenance, signing).

items.name: Recon Agent
items.desc: Subdomain enumeration, port scanning, tech fingerprinting and attack-surface mapping.

items.name: Exploit Chain Composer
items.desc: OWASP chain assembly — from initial bug to high-impact path with CVSS rationale.

items.name: Payload Crafter
items.desc: XSS, SSTI, LFI, SSRF and command-injection payload library with WAF-bypass notes.

items.name: AD Attack Paths
items.desc: BloodHound path review, Kerberos abuse, delegation flaws and Tier-0 hygiene.

items.name: Web Exploit Triage
items.desc: JWT flaws, deserialization, prototype pollution and OAuth misconfigs — triage workflow.

items.name: C2 Hygiene
items.desc: Redirector setup, domain fronting alternatives, OPSEC review and beacon tuning.

items.name: Phishing Sim
items.desc: Campaign design, pretexting, infrastructure and tracking — ethical scope template included.

items.name: Post-Exploitation Playbook
items.desc: Pivoting, persistence, credential access and defense evasion across Win/Linux/cloud.

items.name: Pentest Reporter
items.desc: Finding templates, CVSS scoring, executive summary and remediation roadmap builder.

items.name: IR Runbook
items.desc: Ransomware, BEC and data-exfil playbooks with NIST-aligned phases and comms templates.

items.name: Detection Engineer
items.desc: Sigma rule authoring, KQL and SPL translation with test-harness validation.

items.name: Log Triage
items.desc: CloudTrail, Azure AD and Google Workspace log triage — anomaly patterns per identity.

items.name: SIEM Query Builder
items.desc: Splunk SPL, Sentinel KQL and Elastic EQL cross-translation with performance hints.

items.name: IOC Hunter
items.desc: Threat-intel enrichment, IOC deduplication and confidence scoring across feeds.

items.name: Malware Triage
items.desc: Sandbox output parsing, YARA scaffolding and TTP extraction into ATT&CK mapping.

items.name: Forensics Assist
items.desc: Memory analysis with Volatility, disk imaging hygiene and timeline reconstruction.

items.name: Alert Tuning
items.desc: False-positive reduction with suppression logic, baseline learning and rule hygiene.

items.name: Purple Team Ops
items.desc: Detection validation against ATT&CK — run, measure, close gaps with D3FEND mapping.

items.name: Threat Hunt Session
items.desc: Hypothesis-driven hunt scaffolding — scope, data sources, queries, writeup template.

items.name: ISO 27001 Mapper
items.desc: Annex A control mapping to evidence, policy artifacts and internal-audit prep.

items.name: NIS2 Gap Analysis
items.desc: EU NIS2 directive gap analysis with NL-implementation notes (Cyberbeveiligingswet).

items.name: DORA Compliance
items.desc: Digital Operational Resilience Act controls for EU financial sector — ICT-risk and third-party.

items.name: SOC 2 Type II Prep
items.desc: Trust Services Criteria mapping, evidence collection rhythms and auditor-friendly packaging.

items.name: AVG / GDPR PIA
items.desc: Data Protection Impact Assessment templates with NL Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens guidance.

items.name: Risk Register
items.desc: Likelihood × impact scoring, heatmap generator and treatment-option workflow.

items.name: Policy Drafter
items.desc: AUP, incident-response plan and access-control policy drafting with clause libraries.

items.name: Vendor Security Questionnaire
items.desc: CAIQ, SIG-Lite and custom questionnaire authoring with evidence-reuse lookup.

items.name: Audit Evidence Collector
items.desc: Control-packaged evidence bundling with chain-of-custody and period tagging.
